summary_en: 19,737,531 shares (93.0% S/O) tendered in completed mandatory offer by Ursa 4 K.K.; minimum threshold 14,109,500 shares exceeded; settlement begins 2026-08-03; Ursa 4 becomes parent company and lead major shareholder; incumbent lead shareholder Oka Yasuko and OM Investment K.K. cease to qualify.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Tender Offer for Company Shares by Ursa 4 K.K. and Changes in Parent Company and Lead Major Shareholder
translation_en_brief: On 28 July 2026, J.S.B. Co., Ltd. announced completion of a mandatory tender offer (公開買付け) initiated by Ursa 4 K.K. on 15 June 2026. The offer covered ordinary shares and warrants (新株予約権) and closed on 27 July 2026. A total of 19,737,531 shares and warrant equivalents were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 14,109,500 shares; the offer is therefore declared successful and all tendered securities will be acquired. Settlement begins 2 August 2026. As a result, Ursa 4 K.K. will hold over 50% of voting rights and become the parent company and lead major shareholder, with its parent entities (Ursa 3, Ursa 2, and Ursa 1 K.K.) also qualifying as parent companies through indirect ownership. The incumbent lead shareholder Oka Yasuko and OM Investment K.K. (which tendered all their holdings) will cease to qualify as lead major shareholders. Ursa 4's representative director is Steven G. Glenn; the company was incorporated 25 May 2026 and is 100% owned by Ursa 3 K.K.
